column2:
identical(adj.)完全相同的、一模一樣的
identically(adv.)相同地
identical twins 同卵雙胞胎
identical to 與……完全相同
The two bags look identical, so I took the wrong one.
(這兩個包包看起來一模一樣，所以我拿錯了。)
Her answer was identical to mine.
(她的答案和我的完全相同。)

identification(n.)身分證明、識別、認同
identify(v.)識別
identity(n.)身分
proof of identification 身分證明
identification card 身分證
Please show your identification at the counter.
(請在櫃台出示你的身分證明。)
Fingerprints are often used for identification.
(指紋常被用來辨識身分。)

identify(v.)辨認、確認、認同
identification(n.)識別
identity(n.)身分
identify with 認同、產生共鳴
identify the problem 找出問題
The police identified the man from the video.
(警方從影片中認出了那名男子。)
Many teenagers identify with the main character.
(許多青少年對主角產生共鳴。)

idiom(n.)成語、慣用語
idiomatic(adj.)慣用的、道地的
English idiom 英文慣用語
use an idiom 使用成語
'Break a leg' is an idiom that means 'good luck.'
('Break a leg' 是一句意思為'祝好運'的慣用語。)
Using idioms correctly makes your English sound natural.
(正確使用慣用語能讓你的英文聽起來更道地。)

idle(adj./v.)閒置的、懶散的、無所事事、虛度
idleness(n.)懶惰、閒散
sit idle 閒坐著、閒置
idle away 虛度光陰
The machines sat idle during the holiday.
(假期期間機器都閒置著。)
Don't idle away your summer vacation.
(不要虛度你的暑假。)

idol(n.)偶像
idolize(v.)崇拜
pop idol 流行偶像
teen idol 青少年偶像
The singer is an idol to many teenagers.
(那位歌手是許多青少年的偶像。)
Fans waited for hours to see their idol.
(粉絲們等了好幾個小時只為見偶像一面。)

ignorance(n.)無知、不知道
ignorant(adj.)無知的
ignore(v.)忽視
out of ignorance 出於無知
ignorance of the law 不懂法律
He made the mistake out of ignorance.
(他是出於無知而犯錯。)
Ignorance of the law is no excuse.
(不懂法律不能當作藉口。)

ignorant(adj.)無知的、不知道的
ignorance(n.)無知
ignore(v.)忽視
ignorant of 對……一無所知
ignorant person 無知的人
Many people are ignorant of the dangers of smoking.
(許多人不知道吸菸的危害。)
I felt ignorant when I couldn't answer simple questions.
(我答不出簡單的問題時覺得自己很無知。)

illustrate(v.)說明、闡明、畫插圖
illustration(n.)插圖、說明
illustrator(n.)插畫家
illustrate a point 說明觀點
illustrate a book 為書畫插圖
The teacher used a story to illustrate her point.
(老師用一個故事來說明她的觀點。)
This children's book was illustrated by a famous artist.
(這本童書是由一位知名畫家繪製插圖。)

illustration(n.)插圖、圖解、實例
illustrate(v.)說明、畫插圖
illustrator(n.)插畫家
by way of illustration 作為例證
color illustration 彩色插圖
The book is full of beautiful illustrations.
(這本書充滿了美麗的插圖。)
This chart is a clear illustration of the problem.
(這張圖表清楚地說明了這個問題。)

imaginary(adj.)想像的、虛構的
imagine(v.)想像
imagination(n.)想像力
imaginary friend 想像出來的朋友
imaginary world 虛構的世界
As a child, she had an imaginary friend.
(她小時候有一個想像中的朋友。)
The story takes place in an imaginary world.
(這個故事發生在一個虛構的世界。)

imaginative(adj.)富有想像力的
imagine(v.)想像
imagination(n.)想像力
imaginative child 富想像力的孩子
imaginative design 富有創意的設計
Her imaginative stories always surprise the class.
(她富有想像力的故事總是讓全班驚豔。)
The building has a very imaginative design.
(這棟建築的設計非常有創意。)

imitate(v.)模仿、仿效
imitation(n.)模仿、仿製品
imitator(n.)模仿者
imitate someone's voice 模仿某人的聲音
imitate the behavior 模仿行為
Children often imitate the behavior of their parents.
(孩子常常模仿父母的行為。)
He can imitate the teacher's voice perfectly.
(他能完美模仿老師的聲音。)

imitation(n.)模仿、仿製品
imitate(v.)模仿
imitation leather 人造皮革
do an imitation of 模仿某人
This bag is made of imitation leather.
(這個包包是人造皮革製的。)
He did a funny imitation of our coach.
(他滑稽地模仿了我們的教練。)

immigrant(n.)(外來)移民
immigrate(v.)移入
immigration(n.)移民
new immigrant 新住民
illegal immigrant 非法移民
Many new immigrants in Taiwan come from Southeast Asia.
(台灣許多新住民來自東南亞。)
His grandparents were immigrants from Italy.
(他的祖父母是來自義大利的移民。)

immigrate(v.)移入、(從外國)移居
immigrant(n.)移民
immigration(n.)移民
immigrate to 移民到
immigrate from 從……移民過來
Her family immigrated to Canada ten years ago.
(她的家人十年前移民到加拿大。)
Many people immigrated to America for a better life.
(許多人為了更好的生活移民到美國。)

immigration(n.)移民、入境管理
immigrate(v.)移入
immigrant(n.)移民
immigration office 移民署
go through immigration 通過入境審查
It took an hour to go through immigration at the airport.
(在機場通過入境審查花了一個小時。)
The country changed its immigration policy.
(這個國家改變了移民政策。)

impact(n./v.)影響、衝擊、對……有影響
(無詞性變化)
have an impact on 對……有影響
environmental impact 環境衝擊
Social media has a huge impact on teenagers.
(社群媒體對青少年有巨大的影響。)
The new rule will impact all students.
(新規定將影響所有學生。)

imply(v.)暗示、意味著
implication(n.)含意、影響
implied(adj.)暗示的
imply that 暗示……
clearly imply 明顯暗示
Are you implying that I'm lying?
(你是在暗示我說謊嗎？)
Her silence implied that she was not happy.
(她的沉默暗示她不高興。)

impose(v.)強加、徵(稅)、實施
imposition(n.)強加、負擔
impose a tax 課稅
impose on 強加於、占便宜
The government imposed a tax on sugary drinks.
(政府對含糖飲料課稅。)
Parents should not impose their dreams on their children.
(父母不應把自己的夢想強加在孩子身上。)

impression(n.)印象、感想
impress(v.)使印象深刻
impressive(adj.)令人印象深刻的
first impression 第一印象
make a good impression 留下好印象
First impressions are very important in job interviews.
(第一印象在工作面試中非常重要。)
She made a good impression on her new classmates.
(她給新同學留下了好印象。)

incident(n.)事件、事故
incidental(adj.)附帶的
incidentally(adv.)順便一提
without incident 平安無事
shooting incident 槍擊事件
The school reported the incident to the police.
(學校將這起事件報警處理。)
The trip ended without incident.
(這趟旅程平安無事地結束了。)

including(prep.)包括、包含
include(v.)包括
inclusive(adj.)包含的
including tax 含稅
not including 不包括
The price is 500 dollars, including tax.
(價格是五百元，含稅。)
Everyone came, including my grandparents.
(大家都來了，包括我的祖父母。)

incredible(adj.)難以置信的、驚人的
incredibly(adv.)難以置信地、非常
incredible view 令人驚嘆的景色
incredible story 難以置信的故事
The view from the top of Yushan was incredible.
(玉山山頂的景色令人驚嘆。)
It's incredible that he finished the race with a broken toe.
(他腳趾骨折還跑完比賽，真令人難以置信。)

indication(n.)跡象、指示、表明
indicate(v.)指出、表明
indicator(n.)指標
clear indication 明顯的跡象
give an indication 表明
There is no indication that the rain will stop soon.
(沒有跡象顯示雨很快就會停。)
Her smile was a clear indication that she passed.
(她的笑容明顯表示她通過了。)

infant(n.)嬰兒、幼兒
infancy(n.)嬰兒期、初期
newborn infant 新生兒
infant formula 嬰兒配方奶粉
Infants need to sleep for many hours a day.
(嬰兒一天需要睡很多個小時。)
The nurse is taking care of a newborn infant.
(護理師正在照顧一名新生兒。)

infection(n.)感染、傳染病
infect(v.)感染
infectious(adj.)傳染性的
ear infection 耳朵感染
prevent infection 預防感染
Wash the cut to prevent infection.
(清洗傷口以預防感染。)
The doctor gave him medicine for his ear infection.
(醫生開藥治療他的耳朵感染。)

inflation(n.)通貨膨脹、充氣
inflate(v.)充氣、使膨脹
rate of inflation 通膨率
high inflation 高通膨
Because of inflation, a bowl of noodles now costs more.
(因為通貨膨脹，一碗麵現在變貴了。)
The government is trying to control inflation.
(政府正設法控制通貨膨脹。)

influential(adj.)有影響力的
influence(n./v.)影響
influential person 有影響力的人
highly influential 極具影響力
She is one of the most influential writers in Taiwan.
(她是台灣最具影響力的作家之一。)
Parents are influential in shaping a child's values.
(父母對塑造孩子的價值觀很有影響力。)

informative(adj.)提供資訊的、有教育意義的
inform(v.)通知
information(n.)資訊
informative article 資訊豐富的文章
highly informative 非常有知識性
The museum tour was fun and informative.
(博物館導覽既有趣又富有知識性。)
I found the documentary very informative.
(我覺得那部紀錄片很有教育意義。)

ingredient(n.)原料、成分、要素
(無詞性變化)
main ingredient 主要材料
key ingredient 關鍵要素
Fresh ingredients make the dish taste better.
(新鮮的食材讓菜更好吃。)
Hard work is a key ingredient of success.
(努力是成功的關鍵要素。)

initial(adj./n./v.)最初的、(名字的)首字母、簽姓名首字母
initially(adv.)起初
initiate(v.)開始、發起
initial stage 初期階段
initial reaction 最初的反應
My initial reaction was surprise.
(我最初的反應是驚訝。)
He signed the form with his initials.
(他用姓名縮寫在表格上簽名。)

injure(v.)使受傷、傷害
injury(n.)傷害
injured(adj.)受傷的
seriously injured 受重傷
injure one's knee 傷到膝蓋
Three people were seriously injured in the accident.
(三人在事故中受重傷。)
He injured his knee while playing basketball.
(他打籃球時傷到了膝蓋。)

innocence(n.)無罪、天真、清白
innocent(adj.)無辜的、天真的
prove one's innocence 證明清白
childhood innocence 童真
The man tried hard to prove his innocence.
(那名男子努力證明自己的清白。)
I miss the innocence of my childhood.
(我懷念童年的天真無邪。)

input(n./v.)輸入、投入、意見、輸入(資料)
output(n.)產出
input data 輸入資料
valuable input 寶貴的意見
Thank you for your input on our project.
(謝謝你對我們專題提供的意見。)
Input your password and press Enter.
(輸入你的密碼後按下Enter鍵。)

insert(v./n.)插入、嵌入、插入物
insertion(n.)插入
insert a card 插卡
insert a coin 投幣
Insert your card into the machine.
(把你的卡片插入機器。)
Insert a coin and choose a drink.
(投入硬幣並選擇飲料。)

inspection(n.)檢查、視察
inspect(v.)檢查
inspector(n.)檢查員
safety inspection 安全檢查
on closer inspection 經進一步檢查
All cars must pass a safety inspection.
(所有車輛都必須通過安全檢查。)
On closer inspection, the painting turned out to be fake.
(經進一步檢查，這幅畫原來是假的。)

inspiration(n.)靈感、鼓舞、激勵人心的人或物
inspire(v.)激勵
inspirational(adj.)鼓舞人心的
source of inspiration 靈感來源
draw inspiration from 從……汲取靈感
Nature is a great source of inspiration for artists.
(大自然是藝術家的重要靈感來源。)
Her story is an inspiration to all of us.
(她的故事激勵了我們所有人。)

inspire(v.)激勵、啟發、給予靈感
inspiration(n.)靈感
inspiring(adj.)鼓舞人心的
inspire someone to 激勵某人去……
be inspired by 受……啟發
My English teacher inspired me to study abroad.
(我的英文老師激勵我出國留學。)
The song was inspired by a true story.
(這首歌的靈感來自一個真實故事。)

install(v.)安裝、設置
installation(n.)安裝、設置
install software 安裝軟體
install a camera 安裝攝影機
You need to install the app before using it.
(使用前你需要先安裝這個應用程式。)
The school installed new air conditioners in every classroom.
(學校在每間教室都安裝了新冷氣。)

instinct(n.)本能、直覺
instinctive(adj.)本能的
instinctively(adv.)本能地
survival instinct 求生本能
trust one's instincts 相信直覺
Birds build nests by instinct.
(鳥類靠本能築巢。)
When in doubt, trust your instincts.
(猶豫不決時，相信你的直覺。)

instruct(v.)指示、命令、教導
instruction(n.)指示、說明
instructor(n.)教練、講師
instruct someone to 指示某人做……
as instructed 依照指示
The teacher instructed us to read chapter five.
(老師指示我們閱讀第五章。)
Please fill out the form as instructed.
(請依照指示填寫表格。)

instructor(n.)教練、講師、指導者
instruct(v.)教導
instruction(n.)指示
driving instructor 駕訓班教練
yoga instructor 瑜伽老師
My driving instructor is very patient.
(我的駕訓班教練非常有耐心。)
She works as a part-time yoga instructor.
(她兼職擔任瑜伽老師。)

insult(n./v.)侮辱、辱罵
insulting(adj.)侮辱的
personal insult 人身攻擊
add insult to injury 雪上加霜
He felt insulted when they laughed at his accent.
(他們嘲笑他的口音時，他覺得受到侮辱。)
To add insult to injury, it started to rain.
(更糟的是，天又開始下雨了。)

insurance(n.)保險、保險費
insure(v.)為……投保
health insurance 健康保險
insurance company 保險公司
Taiwan's National Health Insurance covers most people.
(台灣的全民健康保險涵蓋大多數人。)
You should buy travel insurance before going abroad.
(出國前你應該買旅遊保險。)

intellectual(adj./n.)智力的、知識的、知識分子
intellect(n.)智力
intellectual property 智慧財產
intellectual development 智力發展
Reading is important for children's intellectual development.
(閱讀對兒童的智力發展很重要。)
Copying music without permission violates intellectual property rights.
(未經許可複製音樂侵犯了智慧財產權。)

intelligence(n.)智力、智慧、情報
intelligent(adj.)聰明的
artificial intelligence 人工智慧
emotional intelligence 情緒智商
Artificial intelligence is changing the way we learn.
(人工智慧正在改變我們學習的方式。)
Don't insult my intelligence with such a silly excuse.
(別用這麼蠢的藉口來侮辱我的智商。)

intend(v.)打算、意欲
intention(n.)意圖
intended(adj.)預期的、計畫中的
intend to 打算做……
be intended for 為……而設計
I intend to study abroad after graduation.
(我打算畢業後出國留學。)
This book is intended for beginners.
(這本書是為初學者編寫的。)

intense(adj.)強烈的、劇烈的、緊張的
intensity(n.)強度
intensely(adv.)強烈地
intense heat 酷熱
intense competition 激烈的競爭
The intense heat made it hard to sleep.
(酷熱讓人難以入睡。)
There is intense competition to get into top universities.
(進入頂尖大學的競爭十分激烈。)

intensity(n.)強度、強烈、激烈
intense(adj.)強烈的
intensify(v.)加強
high intensity 高強度
the intensity of the light 光線的強度
The typhoon grew in intensity as it moved closer.
(颱風越靠近強度越強。)
High-intensity exercise can burn a lot of calories.
(高強度運動可以燃燒大量熱量。)

intensive(adj.)密集的、加強的
intensively(adv.)密集地
intensive care unit 加護病房
intensive course 密集課程
She took an intensive English course in the summer.
(她暑假參加了英文密集課程。)
The patient was moved to the intensive care unit.
(那名病人被轉入加護病房。)

intention(n.)意圖、打算、目的
intend(v.)打算
intentional(adj.)故意的
good intentions 好意
have no intention of 無意……
I have no intention of giving up.
(我完全不打算放棄。)
He meant well; he had good intentions.
(他是出於好意的。)

interact(v.)互動、相互作用
interaction(n.)互動
interactive(adj.)互動的
interact with 與……互動
interact socially 社交互動
Teachers should interact with students more in class.
(老師在課堂上應該多和學生互動。)
Some medicines can interact with each other.
(有些藥物會彼此產生交互作用。)

interaction(n.)互動、相互作用
interact(v.)互動
interactive(adj.)互動的
social interaction 社交互動
face-to-face interaction 面對面互動
Online games cannot replace face-to-face interaction.
(線上遊戲無法取代面對面的互動。)
The study looks at the interaction between parents and children.
(這項研究探討父母與孩子之間的互動。)

interfere(v.)干涉、妨礙
interference(n.)干涉、干擾
interfere with 妨礙
interfere in 干涉
Don't let your phone interfere with your studies.
(別讓手機妨礙你的課業。)
My parents never interfere in my choices.
(我父母從不干涉我的選擇。)

intermediate(adj./n./v.)中級的、中間的、中級者、調解
(無詞性變化)
intermediate level 中級程度
upper intermediate 中高級
This book is for students at the intermediate level.
(這本書適合中級程度的學生。)
She passed the intermediate level of the GEPT.
(她通過了全民英檢中級。)

interpret(v.)解釋、詮釋、口譯
interpretation(n.)解釋、詮釋
interpreter(n.)口譯員
interpret a dream 解夢
interpret for 為……翻譯
People interpret the poem in many different ways.
(人們對這首詩有許多不同的詮釋。)
She interpreted for the foreign guests at the meeting.
(她在會議上為外賓擔任口譯。)

interruption(n.)中斷、打擾
interrupt(v.)打斷、打擾
without interruption 不間斷地
sorry for the interruption 抱歉打擾了
She studied for three hours without interruption.
(她不間斷地讀了三個小時的書。)
Sorry for the interruption, but you have a phone call.
(抱歉打擾，你有一通電話。)

intimate(adj./n.)親密的、詳盡的、密友
intimacy(n.)親密
intimate friend 密友
intimate knowledge 深入的了解
They have been intimate friends since childhood.
(他們從小就是親密的朋友。)
The guide has an intimate knowledge of the old town.
(這位導遊對老城區瞭若指掌。)

intuition(n.)直覺、直觀
intuitive(adj.)直覺的
female intuition 女性的直覺
rely on intuition 依靠直覺
My intuition told me something was wrong.
(我的直覺告訴我有些不對勁。)
Good players often rely on intuition during a game.
(優秀的選手在比賽中常依靠直覺。)

invade(v.)入侵、侵犯
invasion(n.)入侵
invader(n.)入侵者
invade a country 侵略一個國家
invade one's privacy 侵犯某人隱私
The army invaded the country in 1939.
(軍隊在1939年入侵該國。)
Reading my diary invades my privacy.
(看我的日記是侵犯我的隱私。)

invasion(n.)入侵、侵犯
invade(v.)入侵
military invasion 軍事入侵
